newsitem.title: NORWAY: Oslo Bourse hits all-time high.
newsitem.headline: Oslo Bourse hits all-time high.

text.p: The Norwegian stock exchange soared to all-time highs in morning trade on Wednesday inspired by the U.S. Federal Reserve's decision the night before to hold interest rates steady, dealers said.
The Oslo bourse touched a high of 1,128.76 points after 20 minutes of trade. It then fell back momentarily but climbed again to stand at 1,129.31 at 0830gmt.
Trade was thin, however, at 56 million crowns.
The previous life high of 1,128.71 was set during intra-day trade on February 21. The all-time closing high of 1,128.46 was registered on February 20.
